performance.verdict: Lead collapse is confirmed creative fatigue; 5 overdue SOW milestones compound the risk.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: 2026-07-23 renewal); phone-match attribution, sync cleanup, dashboard, and August scoreboard all undelivered — August prove-it month is at risk.
CPL surged 83.46% in 7d on flat spend (+1.22%); 28-day CPL is $7.46 but the last 7 days show ~13.70 CPL — nearly double the period baseline.
3-day lead signal (Sep 8–10): 4+1+1 = 6 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7): 6+2+4 = 12 — a 50% drop inside an already-declining 7-day window; trend is worsening, not stabilizing.
Spend held flat (~$26/day) while leads fell 44.83% — classic creative fatigue pattern on Meta; no tracking or landing-page change noted to explain the divergence.
GHL shows 102 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — leads are arriving but not converting to booked patients, signaling an intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least 2 new creatives into BWS Retargeting campaign; current set has driven CPL to ~$13.70, double the 28-day $7.46 baseline.
suggestions.monday_update: Launch 2+ new ad creatives into the BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting campaign immediately. The 3-day lead signal dropped to 6 vs 12 the prior 3 days, and CPL has roughly doubled from the 28-day baseline of $7.46 to ~$13.70 over the last 7 days on flat spend. Success check: CPL returns below $9.00 and daily leads average ≥4 over a 3-day window. Re-evaluate by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Escalate intake leak fix: 102 GHL opps created, 0 appointments booked — repair intake workflow before more ad spend is committed.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 102 opportunities created over 28 days with zero appointments and zero won — leads are not being converted to bookings. Audit the GHL intake workflow (auto-responses, Lily's follow-up queue, and Flex Dental handoff) to find where contacts are dropping. Success check: at least 5 confirmed appointments visible in GHL within 7 days of fix. Deadline: 2026-09-16 per the August scoreboard commitment.

suggestions.text: Clear the 5 overdue SOW milestones — dashboard and attribution gap are the two blocking the client's stay/walk renewal decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are overdue, with the oldest dating to 2026-07-23 (renewal closure). The phone-match attribution gap, sync/contact cleanup, and the lead-to-patient dashboard are all undelivered as of 2026-09-11, directly undermining the August scoreboard the client is using to decide renewal. Prioritize the dashboard and attribution gap first; confirm completion in Monday with dated delivery evidence. Both must be done before the next client check-in.
